logp.method_description: To ensure complete saturation of the two phases, a mixture of 20 mL n-octanol and water (1:1 v/v) was vigorously shaken for 24 hours at a constant temperature using an oscillator. Following this, Ir-CW was introduced into a mixture of 1 mL water-saturated n-octanol and 1 mL n-octanol-saturated water to attain a final concentration of 20 µM. The solution was mixed and vortexed overnight on a constant temperature oscillator to guarantee maximum partitioning of the complexes into the respective phases. To determine the concentration of the complexes in each phase, the absorbance of the aqueous phase was measured at 389 nm after reaching a stationary phase.
